title: ProjectNetworkPolicy
description: Project-aware network policy mapping network zones to policy decisions for one project or workspace (spec section 36; routing inputs in spec section 35). Models the section 36 tables: ATLAS (internet allow, corp dev allow, production deny) and PRODUCTION INCIDENT (internet allow, production temporary approval, privileged DB approval required). 'Temporary approval' is expressed as decision 'approval_required' plus an 'expires_at' expiry on the rule. AI network boundaries are enforced below the agent where possible (spec section 36). Runtime JSON record: snake_case fields, strict.
$comment: Network observability records (spec section 37, 'punarctl privacy connections': who is communicating, destination, reason/category, relay route, project, AI session association) are runtime telemetry, deliberately OUT of the v1alpha1 contract layer. Milestone 3 note: crates/punar-common Rust types are not yet reconciled with this schema.

project_id.title: Project identifier
project_id.description: Identifier of the project or workspace this policy applies to, e.g. 'atlas', 'production_incident' (spec section 36; same field name as audit-event project attribution, spec section 53).

display_name.title: Display name
display_name.description: Human-readable workspace label as shown in the spec section 36 tables, e.g. 'ATLAS', 'PRODUCTION INCIDENT'.

rules.title: Zone rules
rules.description: Per-zone policy decisions for this project (spec section 36). Each rule maps one zone name to a decision, optionally with an expiry for temporary grants.

zone_rule.title: Zone rule
zone_rule.description: Decision for one network zone within a project (spec section 36).

zone.title: Zone name
zone.description: Name of the network zone the rule applies to (spec sections 17, 20, 36), e.g. 'internet', 'corp_dev', 'corp_prod', 'privileged_db'. Must match a NetworkZone 'name'.

decision.title: Decision
decision.description: Policy decision for the zone: allow, deny, or approval_required (spec sections 20, 36). The section 36 'temporary approval' is 'approval_required' combined with 'expires_at'; the manifest-local credential value 'request' (spec sections 17, 20) is NOT valid here.

expires_at.title: Expiry
expires_at.description: RFC 3339 instant after which the rule's grant lapses. Optional; with decision 'approval_required' this models the spec section 36 PRODUCTION INCIDENT 'temporary approval' semantics (see also the temporary-activity model, spec section 14.4).
